items.en_oneliner: Robotics firm Microintelligence relaunched its offering on 23 November at HK$12.07-15.69, with subscriptions open 23 November to 1 December and listing on 4 December; it withdrew its October attempt and now seeks up to about HK$585 million. Oversubscribed about 48.85 times.
